query: What market-expansion focus should analysts study?

per_column.name: industry_vertical
per_column.rationale: Provides a strong grouping axis for market-expansion analysis. Values are well-grounded in descriptions (5AM->life sciences, Addepar->fintech). Minor slip: Accel labeled enterprise_software despite a generic VC description, but mostly sound.

per_column.name: business_model_category
per_column.rationale: Distinct, useful axis for comparing expansion strategies. Values track the text (280 Group->professional services, VCs->investment_and_capital). 23andMe as content_and_media is a questionable read but not egregious.

per_column.name: expansion_maturity_stage
per_column.rationale: Maturity is directly relevant to expansion focus. However the descriptions rarely state stage; assigning 'established_public_and_large_cap' to 23andMe or 'growth_stage' to a small consultancy is largely inferred beyond text support.

per_column.name: geographic_ecosystem_position
per_column.rationale: Geographic clustering is highly relevant to market-expansion analysis and grounded in Address fields (Sand Hill Road->VC cluster). Good new axis beyond raw lat/long/city.

per_column.name: ecosystem_strategic_role
per_column.rationale: Adds a functional role dimension (provider vs capital vs infrastructure) useful for ecosystem mapping. Values align with source (VCs->capital_provider). Some overlap with business_model but not fully redundant.

per_column.name: expansion_maturity_signal
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of expansion_maturity_stage using identical value vocabulary; in samples it produces the same value as that column. Adds no new analytical leverage and inherits the same weak grounding for stage inference.

per_column.name: silicon_valley_ecosystem_position
per_column.rationale: Essentially a restatement of geographic_ecosystem_position with identical vocabulary and matching per-row values; trivially redundant, so low usefulness despite being grounded.

judge.rationale: Most columns offer genuine axes (vertical, business model, geography, strategic role) directly relevant to studying market-expansion focus and are well-grounded in descriptions/addresses. Two columns (expansion_maturity_signal, silicon_valley_ecosystem_position) are near-duplicate restatements of other added columns, dragging holistic usefulness down. Groundedness is generally solid; the main weakness is maturity-stage columns asserting specific stages the text seldom states.
